name: Pilot Longbeard
summary: In Ironforge's Military Ward, Pilot Longbeard watches for word from mechanics far away. He is stationed in the Hall of Arms and keeps close to gnomish tinkerers and fellow racing enthusiasts in the Shimmering Flats.

sections.title: A Pilot of the Siege Brigade
sections.body: Pilot Longbeard serves with the Ironforge Siege Brigade in the Military Ward. He listens eagerly for news from mechanics across the continent. Among them are the Brassbolts brothers, who tinker on Kalimdor's salt flats.

sections.title: Connections Across Continents
sections.body: Longbeard points travelers bound for Kalimdor toward the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. There, gnomish inventors push the bounds of machinery alongside their goblin rivals.

faq.q: Where can I find Pilot Longbeard?
faq.answer: Pilot Longbeard is in the Hall of Arms in Ironforge's Military Ward, near the trainers and military displays.
Pilot Longbeard directs Alliance adventurers toward ventures abroad. He especially points them to his friends, the Brassbolts brothers, in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Who are the Brassbolts brothers to Longbeard?
faq.answer: The Brassbolts brothers are gnomish tinkerers and associates of Longbeard in the Shimmering Flats. They share his passion for engineering and experimental machinery.

faq.q: Is Pilot Longbeard related to Furen Longbeard?
faq.answer: Pilot Longbeard and Furen Longbeard share Ironforge's prominent Longbeard clan name, suggesting they may be kin. Pilot Longbeard is concerned with siege engines and engineering connections rather than smithing.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Pilot Longbeard link Ironforge's martial service with siege engines and gnomish mechanics.
As an engineer, you can appreciate the mechanical ingenuity Longbeard values as a siege engine pilot with contacts among gnome tinkerers.
